details: skytext is a malicious PyPI package used in the ChocoPoC campaign, in which fake CVE proof-of-concept repositories on GitHub target vulnerability researchers. A PoC's requirements install frint, which pulls in skytext as a dependency. skytext 1.1.0 (SHA-256 93739477cd379adef95126b22758c0e644282d2028dd297328ce856fa111dd06) ships only precompiled wheels containing a native extension, gradient.so (Linux) or gradient.pyd (Windows). When the extension initializes it decrypts embedded payloads, persists through a .pth file and a trojanized _distutils_hack package, and runs a downloader (choco.py) that retrieves the ChocoPoC Python RAT using Mapbox datasets as a dead-drop resolver. Stolen data is uploaded to 91.132.163.78:8001. Documented by YesWeHack and Sekoia on 2026-07-01, who counted roughly 2,400 downloads of skytext. The package has been removed from PyPI.

files.note: Windows native extension in the skytext wheel: decrypts and drops the ChocoPoC loader (YesWeHack/Sekoia)
